summary: Applied targeted revision-01 fixes against real Minis CLI protocol and DOM fixtures: fixed minis-browser-use subcommands/flags (list_tabs, new_tab --url, navigate --tab-id --url, execute_js --tab-id --script), explicit top-level JS return statements, JSON + trailing tab_id suffix / page_url / data.success=false parsing, strict numeric tab ID parsing, real ?project= query URL, real Gemini 4 Neon High model selector button verification, anti-spoofing project/model validation, real data-testid DOM selectors, raw-string JS regex (eliminating \x08 backspace escape), scoped error scanning excluding user prompt text, old assistant reply isolation, and Verify your account to continue. blocking.
revision_fixes: BrowserUseClient switched to real minis-browser-use actions/flags: list_tabs, new_tab --url, navigate --tab-id ID --url URL, execute_js --tab-id ID --script SCRIPT with strict numeric tab_id validation.
All execute_js scripts now use explicit top-level return (() => { ... })(); and raw Python strings with zero ASCII control characters (eliminating the \x08 backspace regex bug).
parse_browser_envelope now handles data.success=false, data.page_url, strict JSON + bounded trailing \n  tab_id: N suffix, and fail-closed null return handling.
parse_tabs_from_envelope strictly parses real 'Tab N: Title — URL [*]' and 'Opened new tab N at URL' lines into numeric tab IDs and rejects malformed/ambiguous tab lines.

Updated default project URL to https://antigravity.google.com/remote?project=561adc82-06e6-4c8c-862f-3ac493b947c1 and default model to Gemini 4 Neon High; project and model verification now strictly inspect URL ?project= / project selector and model selector button only (never spoofable via prompt/body text).

Updated DOM selectors to real page attributes ([contenteditable=true][aria-label="Message input"], button[data-testid="model-selector-trigger"], button[aria-label^="Select model"], button[aria-label^="Select project, current:"], [data-testid="user-message"], [data-testid="user-message-content"], [data-testid="agent-response"], button[aria-label="Send message"], button[data-testid="send-button"], button[aria-label="Cancel (Ctrl+D)"]).

Scoped error/auth detection to explicit banners, dialogs, URL, and assistant replies AFTER task_marker; added 'Verify your account to continue.' detection while preventing user task text from triggering false blocks and preventing old assistant replies from marking a new task returned.
Added regression tests directly exercising committed orchestration/bootstrap/protocol-fixtures.json.
runtime_unverified_limitations: Local Minis executables (minis-browser-use and minis-mcp-cli) are unavailable in this cloud sandbox; unit and fixture regression tests run against recorded fixtures and mocks only.

Live end-to-end execution of list_tabs, new_tab, navigate, execute_js (focus+selectAll, ClipboardEvent paste, draft/model/project/send inspection, click, status) against the live Antigravity page on iOS Minis has not been executed from this sandbox.
Live GitHub MCP create_branch/create_or_update_file/list_commits/get_file_contents calls on iOS Minis have not been executed end-to-end from this sandbox.
Human sign-in/verification handling, Pro quota enforcement, and iOS app suspension/resume require live runtime verification by GPT on Minis.
